pages.title: Angel Altars
pages.text: Altars are deemed as holy grounds and are most commonly located at high altitudes. At their center there is a divine construct, above which floats a $(l:offsprings/angel)$(c)$(o)Blood Ophanim$(), the weakest type of angel. It will smite down all trespassers that come close to the Altar. It should only be approached if the violator is equipped with $(l:materials/memory_core)$(c)$(o)willful weaponry$().

pages.title: Circular Angel Altar
pages.text: The use of a $(e)Totem of Undying$() at the Angel Altar will call down a new Ophanim.
